notes.title: Playtest update #2
notes.notes:
This is a major version update, local saves will be reset.

- New rules, combat is now 1dx+att vs 1dx+def
- Swapped Worg and Spectre
- XP are fixed per monsters, not computed
- Focus bug fixes
- Right buttons are disabled when not available
- Add Steam achievements (unlock at normal difficulty at least)
- Add Steam leaderboards (at normal difficulty at least)
- Fast combat setting is replaced by Veteran and Voidcall achievements
- Add Reset button is restart a quickly restart a run
